def comp_depth(labels, cid):
    S=(labels==cid)
    d=np.full(S.shape,-1,int)
    remain=S.copy(); k=0
    # chessboard erosion: peel all cells that touch outside (incl grid) in 8-neighborhood
    while remain.any():
        # mark pixels with any outside neighbor
        padded=np.pad(remain,1,constant_values=False)
        interior=np.ones_like(remain,bool)
        for dr in (-1,0,1):
            for dc in (-1,0,1):
                if dr==dc==0: continue
                neighbor=padded[1+dr:1+dr+n,1+dc:1+dc+n]
                interior &= neighbor
        layer=remain & ~interior
        # also boundary due to cells diagonally neighboring other components is captured as not remain
        if not layer.any():
            raise Exception('stuck')
        d[layer]=k
        remain &= ~layer
        k+=1
    return d
D=[]
for cid,p in enumerate(comps):
 d=comp_depth(labels,cid); D.append(d)
 pts=[(r,c,int(A[r,c]),int(d[r,c])) for r,c in p if A[r,c]!=8]
 print(cid, 'markers',pts,'maxdepth',d.max())
